text: What is the capital of Australia? Answer in one sentence.
What is the chemical symbol for gold? Be brief.
Who wrote the novel "Pride and Prejudice"? Be brief.
Which is the largest planet in our solar system? Be brief.
In which year did humans first land on the Moon? Be brief.
What is the capital city of the fictional country of Zorblax? If you do not know or it does not exist, say so.
What is 17 multiplied by 23? Give the number and a one-line explanation.
A train leaves at 3:15 PM and travels 180 km at 60 km/h. At what time does it arrive? Be brief.
If 5 machines take 5 minutes to make 5 widgets, how long would 100 machines take to make 100 widgets? Be brief.
A shirt costs $40 and is discounted by 25%. What is the new price? Be brief.
What is the next number in the sequence 2, 6, 18, 54, ...? Be brief.

Is 91 a prime number? Reply with only the single word "yes" or "no".
Write one sentence about the ocean that has exactly 7 words. Output only the sentence.
Write the word banana in all capital letters and output nothing else.
Give three colors, in lowercase, separated by commas, with no other text.
Translate "Good morning" into French. Reply with only the translation.
Return only a JSON object with the keys "title", "year" and "rating" describing a fictional movie. No other text.
Return only a JSON array containing the first 5 prime numbers. No other text.
Return only a JSON object where "a" is the number 1 and "b" is the array [1, 2, 3]. No other text.
Write a Python function named is_even(n) that returns True if n is even. Code only.
In Python, what is the shortest way to reverse a string s? Be brief.
